places_note: Select a place to approach its architecture.
inspector_toggle_hint: Collapse or expand the place study panel
inspector_empty: Choose a place from the list or click a visible landmark.
cutaway_note: Inspection cutaway: the covering ground and roof are hidden to expose this underground reservoir.
interior_note: Architectural inspection · Tab captures the mouse; WASD move, Q/E rise and descend. These interiors are interpretive.
editor_note: Your additions form a separate local variant. Historical architecture stays in place.
count_template: %d additions · separate from the historical baseline
saved: Creative variant saved in the study's own user folder.
save_error: The creative variant could not be saved. Check the study user folder's available space and permissions.
load_missing: There is no saved creative variant in this study's user folder yet.
load_error: The saved file is not a valid variant for this city. The current design was retained.
load_clamped: Creative variant loaded; rotations and sizes were constrained to this study's limits.
placement_limit: This variant has reached its limit of 500 additions. Delete an addition before placing another.
placed: Addition placed. Rotate, resize or save it in the creative workshop.
pick_addition: Click an addition in the scene to select it.
placement_active: Click clear terrain to place the selected kit. Escape leaves placement mode.
placement_outside: Choose visible land inside the study boundary.
cleared: Creative additions cleared. Undo restores the previous design.
ready: City assembled. Choose a place or explore the skyline.
camera_view: City inspection view · orbit, pan and zoom to explore.
data_error: The city data could not be loaded. Reopen the complete study package.
screenshot_error: The screenshot could not be saved to this study's user folder.
help_orbit: Right-drag orbit · middle-drag pan · wheel zoom · H hide panels · F12 capture
help_fly: Tab capture mouse · WASD move · Q/E descend/rise · Shift faster · Escape release · H panels
help_walk: Tab capture mouse · WASD walk · Shift faster · Escape release · H panels · terrain walking
walk_note: Walking follows terrain and available building obstacles; unsupported interiors are exterior studies.
